classification.difficultyReason: Read the intervals where each supplied parabola is below or on/above the x-axis, distinguishing strict and inclusive endpoints.

content.prompt: Solve each quadratic inequation, using the graph provided.

spec.description: Unshaded upward parabola with both upper branch arrowheads, positive-axis arrows, x and y labels, and only the −2 intercept labelled. The origin intercept is unlabelled.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied graph remains visible in the question; no solution interval is marked.

answer.worked:
The graph is below the $x$-axis between its intercepts at $x=-2$ and $x=0$. The strict inequality excludes both intercepts.

Hence $-2<x<0$.

spec.description: Unshaded upward parabola; x-intercepts labelled −4 and 2; y-intercept labelled −8; additional y-axis tick labelled 1; both upper branches and positive axes have arrowheads.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied graph remains visible in the question; no solution intervals are marked.

answer.worked:
The graph is above the $x$-axis to the left of $x=-4$ and to the right of $x=2$, and is on the axis at these intercepts. Include both intercepts because the inequality is $\ge$.

Hence $x\le-4$ or $x\ge2$.
